name: STAR1
summary: A full-size humanoid from RobotEra, a Tsinghua University–linked Beijing startup. In a 2024 outdoor test STAR1 was clocked running at around 3.6 m/s — briefly the fastest reported humanoid running speed — with the company crediting its lightweight build and high-torque joints. RobotEra also develops the XBot data-collection platform and later Q5 and L7 models.
notable: Held the humanoid running-speed record (~3.6 m/s) in 2024
